what_it_does: Develops a performance-portable distributed Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) software layer using the Kokkos library, which is a C++ framework for writing code that runs efficiently on CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs. The work adds new features including batched distributed FFT and connects to vendor-optimized mathematical libraries. The goal is to simplify development of FFT code that achieves good performance across different hardware without requiring developers to rewrite optimizations for each specific device type.
